verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance and screening platform, since buyers can ask about on-premise deployment, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents ComplyAdvantage Mesh as a hosted web application and API, with no on-premise, private-cloud or self-hosted deployment option. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
